student_learning_goal: I can find the missing number that makes two expressions equal.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can find the missing number that makes two expressions equal.
header.character_watermark: Bella in the top-right corner with a question mark. Small (~1.5in tall).

parts.student_instructions: Find the missing number in each addition equation.
parts.visual_layout: Top of the page. Eight rows in a 4x2 grid.

image_placeholders.description: Eight missing-addition equations in B&W line-art, 4-row × 2-column grid. Each ~3.5in × 0.7in. Equations: 4+?=7, ?+5=9, 6+?=10, ?+3=8, 5+?=12, ?+4=11, 8+?=15, ?+7=15.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS03_P1_EIGHT_ADDS: keywords (missing, addition) name what the equations ask for.

parts.student_instructions: Find the missing number in each subtraction equation.
parts.visual_layout: Middle. Six rows in a 3x2 grid.

image_placeholders.description: Six missing-subtraction equations in B&W line-art, 3-row × 2-column grid. Each ~3.5in × 0.7in. Equations: 8-?=5, ?-2=4, 10-?=3, ?-3=2, 9-?=4, ?-4=6.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS03_P2_SIX_SUBS: keywords (missing, subtraction) name what the equations ask for.

parts.student_instructions: Each balance shows one side counted. Write the equation and find the missing number.
parts.visual_layout: Bottom of the page. Three balance drawings stacked.

image_placeholders.description: Three balance scale drawings in B&W line-art, stacked vertically. Each ~7in × 1.5in. Pre-fills: B1 left=4 counters, right=7 counters (mystery: how many to add to left?). B2 left=? counters, right=8 counters (mystery: how many on left?). B3 left=10 counters, right=? counters with subtract-3 label (mystery: 10-?=3).
image_placeholders.placement: Bottom of the page; three drawings stacked.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS03_P3_THREE_BALANCES: keywords (balance) name what the drawings ask for.

parts.answer_key: B1: 4+?=7, mystery 3. B2: ?=8, mystery 8. B3: 10-?=3, mystery 7.

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, write 3 missing-number puzzles of your own. Solve them.
teacher_notes: Lesson 3 consolidation. Watch Part 1 children who add 4+7=11 instead of finding 3 — flag for operator-as-instruction reteach.
